title: Bind the AMP discriminator seed to the run seed and keep failed cleanup snapshots
summary: Every AMP run seed shared one discriminator initialization and one row-sampling generator because the discriminator seed was the constant 20260925. The learner now uses the run seed plus 8 unless the configuration names a seed, so the default run seed 20260917 keeps the former value. The recorded learner configuration holds the resolved seed. The native launcher also saves cleanup.json when the final host snapshot fails; the record stores the error under the host key.
next: Review and merge the pull request before the Step 5 flat AMP pilot in issue 37.
reason: No native AMP pilot has run, and the launcher change affects only the cleanup record after a failed host query; no roadmap marker, recorded fact, gate or published result changes.
